name: Gate an agent's code edits on reviewed intents
description: The Lastro plugin for Claude Code and Codex (plugins/lastro) is active in a repository that has .lastro/plugin.json. Its PreToolUse hook treats the first attempt to edit source code, in any mode (plan mode, auto mode, an informal plan or none), as the moment to extract intents: edit tools (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, apply_patch) on code outside .lastro/ and outside the configured allow globs are denied, with steps to write the change as prose in .lastro/proposals/<id>-<slug>.md, run lastro propose and start the user's review, unless the current proposal is approved, its proofs were derived from exactly its current intents and decisions, and its last proof run has not passed yet. Once every proof passes, the next source edit is a new change and is denied the same way. With gate "off" it never blocks. Proposals and handoff answers inside .lastro/ are always allowed; the proposal and use-case JSON files, receipts, config.json and the plugin's state are denied because only the CLI writes them; edits to .lastro/plugin.json ask the user in Claude Code and are denied in Codex. SessionStart adds the progress board and the rule that the agent is the author of the proposal and never approves it; UserPromptSubmit adds one short line (the board summary and that rule) only when the summary changed since the agent of that session last got it, and nothing otherwise.
